headline: Papua New Guinea Demands Domestic Processing for Ramu Nickel
summary: Prime Minister James Marape stated that a proposed $1.6 billion expansion of the Ramu Nickel project must incorporate downstream mineral processing within Papua New Guinea to receive regulatory approval.
why: Resource nationalism policies in developing Pacific economies aim to extract greater fiscal and industrial value from foreign-operated nickel and cobalt mines.

impacts.name: Papua New Guinea Mining
impacts.why: Mandatory downstream refining terms may raise capital costs for foreign operators of the Ramu mine.
